subject: Starlake Health MAP kickoff — legal/procurement roster & timelines
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Vega <alicia.vega@starlakehealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Starlake MAP kickoff — legal/procurement roster & timelines

Alicia —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. As discussed on the call, we'd like to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align on evaluation steps, contracting milestones, and the redline process so we can get to a production contract quickly.

I attached a draft MAP (MAP-draft-v1.pdf) that lays out a proposed 6-week timeline. High-level asks from Redwood:
- Procurement point of contact for PO/approved vendor flow
- Legal contact for redlines and expected review window
- Any procurement or security evidence we should prep in advance (SOC2, DPA language, IP/QoS requirements)

Proposed near-term milestones (flexible):
1) Discovery + MAP finalization - by 2027-05-20
2) Eval + pilot (internal) - 2027-05-21 to 2027-06-04
3) Contract redlines exchanged - target start 2027-06-07
4) Legal sign-off & counter-signature - by 2027-06-18

Would you share the names/email addresses for your procurement and legal owners so we can add them to the MAP and set a short kickoff call (30 min) to confirm responsibilities? We can be flexible on timing — propose Tue or Wed next week.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Email: tessa.morgan@redwood.com | Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (16kb)

From: Alicia Vega <alicia.vega@starlakehealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@starlakehealth.com>, Luis Romero <luis.romero@starlakehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Starlake MAP kickoff — legal/procurement roster & timelines

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the MAP draft and clear timeline. Quick answers below and apologies for the brief note:

Procurement lead: Alicia Vega (me) — procurement@starlakehealth.com (I manage vendor onboarding and PO flow)
Legal lead: Luis Romero (cc'd) — luis.romero@starlakehealth.com

A couple notes from procurement:
- Standard vendor onboarding typically needs a W-9, vendor form, and our standard terms (we can accept DocuSign).
- For contracting cadence, we usually allow 3-5 business days for initial redline review and up to 10 bd for more complex legal changes.

Luis — can you confirm legal's preferred redline format (track changes Word vs annotated PDF) and whether you need an initial clean SOW to attach?

We can do a 30-min kickoff on Tue 5/18 at 10:00am PT or Wed 5/19 at 9:00am PT — which works for you?

Best,
Alicia
Alicia Vega
Director, Procurement | Starlake Health
procurement@starlakehealth.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Vega <alicia.vega@starlakehealth.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:36:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Starlake MAP kickoff — legal/procurement roster & timelines

Alicia / Tessa —

Appreciate the quick reply and the contacts. Looping Marissa (our contract ops lead) so she can drive the redline exchange and DocuSign setup. To keep things actionable, here's a lightly firmed-up contracting roadmap based on the MAP draft and your timelines:

Milestones (proposed targets):
- 2027-05-18: MAP kickoff call (confirming owners & artifacts)
- 2027-05-20: Redwood to deliver clean SOW + SLA summary (SLA-summary.xlsx attached)
- 2027-06-07: Initial redline package delivered by Starlake legal
- 2027-06-11: Redwood internal review and response to redlines
- 2027-06-16: Final legal agreement for signatures
- 2027-06-18: Signatures / contract executed (target)

Process notes:
- Preferred redline workflow: Marissa will accept either Word with track changes or a marked-up PDF; if you have a markups-only process please advise.
- For quick turnaround, we recommend including a short memo with material legal asks (e.g., indemnity caps, data residency) when you send redlines so we can triage risk faster.
- We'll prepare a DocuSign envelope once both parties agree on the final language — can you confirm whether Starlake requires countersignature by a specific role/title?

Attachment: SLA-summary.xlsx (9kb)

Available for the 10:00am PT slot on Tue 5/18 if needed.

— Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (628) 555-0199
From: Luis Romero <luis.romero@starlakehealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@starlakehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Starlake MAP kickoff — legal/procurement roster & timelines

Hi Tessa / Sean —

Thanks for the heads-up and the clear milestone grid. A few quick confirmations from legal:
- Preferred format: Word with track changes is best for us (PDF annotations cause versioning friction).
- Initial review window: we can commit to 5 business days for a first-pass, with an aim to close within 10 business days for typical commercial terms. If you foresee material indemnity or data residency asks, flag those early.
- Signature role: our VP of Finance is the authorized signatory for vendor agreements above $75k ARR — I'll coordinate internally if exceptions are needed.

Two small requests to speed review: please include (1) a single-paragraph summary of the proposed indemnity/liability caps in the SOW cover page, and (2) any security addenda references (SOC2 report link or a short evidence list).

Happy to join a short call to walk through the redline approach after the kickoff — available Wed 5/19 afternoon PT.

Regards,
Luis Romero
Senior Counsel | Starlake Health
luis.romero@starlakehealth.com
Attachment: redline-guidelines.docx (4kb)
